style=\"background-color: white; color: #757575; font-size: 15px;\"\u003EThis is an online e-log book to discuss our patient's de-identified health data shared after taking his\/her\/guardian's informed consent. Here we discuss our individual patient's problems through series of inputs from available global online community of experts with an aim to solve those patient's clinical problems with collective current best evidence based inputs.\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"background-color: white;\"\u003EDate of admission :\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/span\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"background-color: white;\"\u003E\u0026nbsp;04 February 2022\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"background-color: white;\"\u003EA\u0026nbsp; 50 year old male who works in a hotel came to the OPD with the chief complaint of loss of consciousness\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"background-color: white;\"\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"background-color: white;\"\u003EHistory of present illness :\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"background-color: white;\"\u003EThe patient was apparently asymptomatic one day before.\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"background-color: white;\"\u003EHe had a night meal with 90 ml of whisky which was his daily routine.\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"background-color: white;\"\u003EHe later experienced discomfort, started behaving abnormally as in talking irrelevant things and lost consciousness.\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"background-color: white;\"\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"background-color: white;\"\u003EHistory of past illness :\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"background-color: white;\"\u003EPatient is diabetic since 15 years (experienced giddiness and got checked)\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"background-color: white;\"\u003EThe patient was injured by a motor vehicle silencer\u0026nbsp; 4 months back and the injury later progressed to form an ulcer leading to amputation of three toes of right leg.\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThe patient is not a known case of epilepsy, tuberculosis, asthma, hypertension\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EPersonal history :\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E- The patient has no loss of appetite\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E- He takes mixed diet\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E- No sleep disturbances\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E- He stopped smoking 15 years back but consumes alcohol occasionally\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EFamily history :\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E- There are no similar complaints in the family members\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ETreatment history :\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E- The patient is on oral hypoglycemic agents (glimepiride) but has a habit of skipping the medications.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E- She is not a known case of drug allergy.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EGeneral examination :\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E- Patient is not conscious, coherent, cooperative at the time of joining\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E- Pallor present\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E- No icterus\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E- No cyanosis\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E- No clubbing of fingers and toes\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E- No lymphadenopathy\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E- Bilateral pedal edema is absent\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EVitals : temperature - 91°F\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp;Pulse rate - 91 bpm\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp;Respiratory rate - 24 cycles per minute\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u0026nbsp; This E log book also reflects my patient- centered online learning portfolio and your valuable inputs on the comment.\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"background-color: #f3f3f3; font-family: georgia;\"\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"background-color: #f3f3f3; font-family: georgia;\"\u003EA 50 year old female came to OPD with chief complaints of shortness of breath and bipedal edema.\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"background-color: #f3f3f3; font-family: georgia;\"\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"background-color: #f3f3f3; font-family: georgia;\"\u003EHISTORY OF PRESENT ILLNESS:\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"background-color: #f3f3f3; font-family: georgia;\"\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"background-color: #f3f3f3; font-family: georgia;\"\u003E\u0026nbsp;Patient was apparently asymptomatic 3years back, then she complaints of headache to which she was diagnosed as hypertension. She is on medication since then.\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"background-color: #f3f3f3; font-family: georgia;\"\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"background-color: #f3f3f3; font-family: georgia;\"\u003E8months back, patient complaints of shortness of breath which is aggravated during supine position and she\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/span\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"background-color: #f3f3f3; font-family: georgia;\"\u003Ecomplaints of pedal edema which is pitting in nature and decrease urine output to which she was admitted to KIMS. She was diagnosed as chronic kidney disease.
